fields.en: Does your university as a body have targets to admit students who fall into the bottom 20% of household income group (or a more tightly defined target) in the country?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有招收國內最低所得 20% 家庭學生（或更嚴格定義目標）之目標？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have graduation/completion targets for students who fall into the bottom 20% of household income group (or a more tightly defined target) in the country? (domestic)
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有國內最低所得 20% 家庭學生（或更嚴格定義目標）之畢業／完成學業目標？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide support (e.g. food, housing, transportation, legal services) for students from low income families to enable them to complete university?
fields.zh: 貴校是否提供低收入家庭學生支持（如食物、住宿、交通、法律服務），以協助其完成大學學業？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have programmes or initiatives to assist students who fall into the bottom 20% of household income group (or a more tightly defined target) in the country to successfully complete their studies?
fields.zh: 貴校是否有計畫或措施，協助國內最低所得 20% 家庭學生（或更嚴格定義目標）順利完成學業？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have schemes to support poor students from low or lower-middle income countries (e.g. offering free education, grants)?
fields.zh: 貴校是否有方案支持來自低度或中低所得國家之清寒學生（如免費教育、獎助金）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide assistance in the local community supporting the start-up of financially and socially sustainable businesses through relevant education or resources? (e.g. mentorship programmes, training workshops, access to university facilities)? Yes Yes
fields.zh: 貴校是否透過相關教育或資源（如導師制度、培訓工作坊、開放大學設施），協助地方社區創立財務與社會上可持續之事業？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide financial assistance to the local community assisting the start-up of financially and socially sustainable businesses?
fields.zh: 貴校是否提供地方社區財務協助，支持創立財務與社會上可持續之事業？

fields.en: Does your university as a body organise training or programmes to improve access to basic services for all?
fields.zh: 貴校是否辦理培訓或計畫，讓更多人能使用基本服務？

fields.en: Does your university as a body participate in policy making at local, regional, national and/or global level to implement programmes and policies to end poverty in all its dimensions?
fields.zh: 貴校是否參與地方、區域、國家或全球層級之政策制定，以推動終結各面向貧窮之計畫與政策？

fields.en: Does your university as a body measure the amount of food waste generated from food served within the university? If food provision is outsourced this will include requiring this data to be tracked.
fields.zh: 貴校是否量測校內供餐所產生之食物浪費量？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a programme in place on student food insecurity/hunger?
fields.zh: 貴校是否已有因應學生糧食不安全之計畫？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide interventions to prevent or alleviate hunger among students? (e.g. including supply and access to food banks/pantries)
fields.zh: 貴校是否提供措施，預防或減輕學生飢餓（例如食物銀行／食物儲備，讓學生能取得食物）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide sustainable food choices for all on campus, including vegetarian and vegan food?
fields.zh: 貴校是否為校園所有人提供永續飲食選擇，包括素食與純素？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide healthy and affordable food choices for all on campus?
fields.zh: 貴校是否為校園所有人提供健康且可負擔之飲食選擇？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide interventions to prevent or alleviate hunger among staff? (e.g. including supply and access to food banks/pantries)
fields.zh: 貴校是否提供措施，預防或減輕教職員飢餓（例如食物銀行／食物儲備，讓教職員能取得食物）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide access on food security and sustainable agriculture and aquaculture knowledge, skills or technology to local farmers and food producers?
fields.zh: 貴校是否向地方農民與食品生產者提供糧食安全及永續農漁養殖的知識、技能或技術？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide events for local farmers and food producers to connect and transfer knowledge?
fields.zh: 貴校是否辦理活動，供地方農民與食品生產者交流並移轉知識？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide access to university facilities (e.g. labs, technology, plant stocks) to local farmers and food producers to improve sustainable farming practices?
fields.zh: 貴校是否開放大學設施（如實驗室、技術、種苗）予地方農民與食品生產者，以改善永續農業實務？

fields.en: Does your university as a body prioritise purchase of products from local, sustainable sources?
fields.zh: 貴校是否優先採購來自地方、永續來源之產品？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have current collaborations with local, national or global health institutions to improve health & wellbeing outcomes?
fields.zh: 貴校是否與地方、國家或全球健康機構有現行合作，以改善健康與福祉成果？

fields.en: Does your university as a body deliver outreach programmes and projects in the local community (which can include student volunteering programmes) to improve or promote health & wellbeing including hygiene, nutrition, family planning, sports, exercise, aging well, and other health and wellbeing related topics? Yes Yes
fields.zh: 貴校是否在地方社區辦理外展計畫與專案（可含學生志工），以改善或推廣健康與福祉（含衛生、營養、家庭計畫、運動、健身、健康老化等）？亦可包含對機構所在地流離失所或難民社區之外展。

fields.en: Does your university as a body share sports facilities with the local community, for instance with local schools or with the general public?
fields.zh: 貴校是否與地方社區共享運動設施（例如地方學校或一般大眾）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide students access to sexual and reproductive health-care services including information and education services?
fields.zh: 貴校是否提供學生性與生殖健康照護服務（含資訊與教育）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide students with access to mental health support?

fields.en: Does your university as an educational body host events at university that are open to the general public: executive education programmes (this refers to short courses for people who are not attending the university; this specifically excludes courses like MBA) and/or vocational training? Yes Yes
fields.zh: 貴校是否舉辦對一般大眾開放之活動：高階主管教育（指非在校生之短期課程，不含 MBA 等）或職業訓練？

fields.en: Does your university as a body undertake educational outreach activities (e.g. tailored lectures or demonstrations) beyond campus, e.g. in local schools, in the community, including voluntary student-run schemes?
fields.zh: 貴校是否在校園外（地方學校、社區）辦理教育外展活動（如客製講座或示範）？可含學生志工方案。

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a policy that ensures that access to these activities is accessible to all, regardless of ethnicity, religion, disability, immigration status or gender?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有政策，確保上述活動不因族群、宗教、身心障礙、移民身分或性別而無法參與？

fields.en: Does your university as a body systematically measure/track women's application rate and acceptance or entry rate?
fields.zh: 貴校是否系統性量測並追蹤女性申請率、錄取率或入學率？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a policy (e.g. an Access and Participation plan) addressing women's applications, acceptance/entry, and participation at the university?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有政策（例如協助入學與參與的計畫），處理女性申請、錄取、入學與參與？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide women's access schemes (e.g. mentoring, scholarships, or other provisions)?
fields.zh: 貴校是否提供協助女性入學或參與的方案（含導師制度、獎學金或其他措施）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body encourage applications by women in subjects where they are underrepresented?

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a policy of non-discrimination against women?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有禁止歧視女性之政策？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a policy of non-discrimination for transgender people?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有對跨性別者不歧視之政策？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a maternity policy that support women's participation?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有支持女性參與之孕產相關政策？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have accessible childcare facilities for students which allow recent mothers to attend university courses?
fields.zh: 貴校是否提供學生可使用的托育設施，讓剛生產的母親也能修課？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have childcare facilities for staff and faculty?
fields.zh: 貴校是否為教職員提供托育設施？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have women's mentoring schemes, in which at least 10% of female students participate?
fields.zh: 貴校是否有女性導師制度方案，且至少 10% 女性學生參與？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have measurement/tracking of women's likelihood of graduating compared to men's, and schemes in place to close any gap?
fields.zh: 貴校是否量測／追蹤女性相對男性之畢業可能性，並有縮小差距之方案？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a policy that protects those reporting discrimination from educational or employment disadvantage?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有政策，保護檢舉歧視者不致遭受教育或就業不利？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a paternity policy that support women's participation by ensuring that non-gestational parents can participate in childcare duties?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有陪產／育嬰相關政策，確保父親可參與育兒以支持女性參與？

fields.en: Does your university as a body measure the total volume of water used in the university that is taken from mains supply, desalinated, or extracted from rivers, lakes, or acquifers?
fields.zh: 貴校是否量測自來水、淡化水，或自河川、湖泊、含水層抽取之總用水量？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a process in place to treat waste water?
fields.zh: 貴校是否已有廢水處理程序？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have processes to prevent polluted water entering the water system, including pollution caused by accidents and incidents at the university?
fields.zh: 貴校是否有程序防止污染水進入水系統（含校內事故與事件造成之污染）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide free drinking water for students, staff and/or visitors, e.g. drinking water fountains)?
fields.zh: 貴校是否為學生、教職員或訪客提供免費飲用水（如飲水機）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body apply building standards to minimise water use? (relevant standards to be indicated)
fields.zh: 貴校是否採用建築標準以最小化用水？

fields.en: Does your university as a body plant landscapes to minimise water usage?
fields.zh: 貴校是否以最小化用水方式規劃景觀植栽（如耐旱植物）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a policy to maximise water reuse across the university?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有最大化全校水再利用之政策？

fields.en: Does your university as a body measure the reuse of water across the university?
fields.zh: 貴校是否量測全校水再利用情形？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide educational opportunities for local communities to learn about good water management?
fields.zh: 貴校是否為地方社區提供優良水資源管理之教育機會？

fields.en: Does your university as a body support water conservation off campus?
fields.zh: 貴校是否支持校外實務節水？

fields.en: Does your university as a body, where water is extracted (for example from aquifers, lakes or rivers), utilise sustainable water extraction technologies on associated university grounds on and off campus?
fields.zh: 若有取水（如自含水層、湖泊或河川），貴校是否在相關校地（校內外）使用永續取水技術？

fields.en: Does your university as a body cooperate with local, regional, national or global governments on water security?
fields.zh: 貴校是否與地方、區域、國家或全球政府就水安全合作？

fields.en: Does your university as a body actively promote conscious water usage on campus?
fields.zh: 貴校是否積極在校園推廣有意識之用水？

fields.en: Does your university as a body actively promote conscious water usage in the wider community?
fields.zh: 貴校是否積極在更廣泛社區推廣有意識之用水？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a policy in place for ensuring all renovations / new builds are following energy efficiency standards? (relevant standards to be indicated)
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有政策，確保所有整修或新建遵循能源效率標準？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have plans to upgrade existing buildings to higher energy efficiency?
fields.zh: 貴校是否有計畫將既有建築升級至更高能源效率？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a process for carbon management and reducing carbon dioxide emissions?
fields.zh: 貴校是否有碳管理及減少二氧化碳排放之程序？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have an energy efficiency plan in place to reduce overall energy consumption?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有能源效率計畫以降低整體能源消耗？

fields.en: Does your university as a body undergo energy reviews to identify areas where energy wastage is highest?
fields.zh: 貴校是否進行能源檢視，以找出能源浪費最高之區域？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a policy on divesting investments from carbon-intensive energy industries especially coal and oil?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有自高碳密集能源產業（尤其煤與石油）撤資之政策？

fields.zh: 貴校是否提供地方社區認識能源效率與潔淨能源重要性之計畫？

fields.en: Does your university as a body promote a public pledge toward 100% renewable energy (petitions, meetings, discussions, events) beyond the university?
fields.zh: 貴校是否推動校園外邁向 100% 再生能源之公開承諾？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide direct services to local industry aimed at improving energy efficiency and clean energy (energy efficiency assessments, workshops, research renewable energy options)
fields.zh: 貴校是否向地方產業提供直接服務，以改善能源效率與潔淨能源（能源效率評估、工作坊、再生能源選項研究）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body inform and support government in clean energy and energy-efficient technology policy development?
fields.zh: 貴校是否協助政府發展潔淨能源與節能技術政策？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide assistance for start-ups that foster and support a low-carbon economy/technology?
fields.zh: 貴校是否協助推動低碳經濟或技術之新創？

fields.en: Does your university as a body pay all staff and faculty at least the living wage, defined as the local living wage (if government defines this) or the local poverty indicator for a family of four (expressed as an hourly wage)?
fields.zh: 貴校是否支付全體教職員至少基本生活工資（以地方政府定義之生活工資，或以四口之家貧困指標換算之時薪）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body recognise unions for all, including women & international staff?
fields.zh: 貴校是否承認全體（含女性與國際員工）之工會（結社自由與集體協商）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a policy on ending discrimination in the workplace (including discrimination based on religion, sexuality, gender, age)?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有終結職場歧視之政策（含宗教、性傾向、性別、年齡或難民身分）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a policy commitment against forced labour, modern slavery, human trafficking, and child labour?

fields.zh: 上述政策是否延伸至委外供應商與供應鏈（如設備、文具、營建合約供應商）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a university Climate Action plan, shared with local government and/or local community groups?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有氣候行動計畫，並與地方政府及地方社區團體共享？

fields.en: Does your university as a body participate in co-operative planning for climate change disasters, that may include the displacement of people both within a country and across borders, working with government?
fields.zh: 貴校是否與政府參與氣候變遷災害合作規劃（可含國內及跨境人口流離）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body inform and support local or regional government in local climate change disaster/risk early warning and monitoring?

fields.en: Does your university as a body collaborate with NGOs on climate adaptation?
fields.zh: 貴校是否與 NGO 就氣候調適合作？

fields.zh: 貴校是否依溫室氣體盤查議定書訂有達成碳中和之目標日期？

fields.zh: 貴校是否支持或舉辦活動，推廣海洋、海域、湖泊、河川與海洋資源之保育與永續利用？

fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有政策，確保校園來自水生生態系之食品為永續採收？

fields.en: Does your university as a body work directly (research and/or engagement with industries) to maintain and extend existing ecosystems and their biodiversity, of both plants and animals, especially ecosystems under threat?
fields.zh: 貴校是否直接（研究或與產業合作）維護並擴展既有生態系及其動植物生物多樣性，尤其受威脅生態系？

fields.en: Does your university as a body work directly (research and/or engagement with industries) on technologies or practices that enable marine industry to minimise or prevent damage to aquatic ecosystems?
fields.zh: 貴校是否直接（研究或與產業合作）發展技術或實務，使海洋產業能最小化或防止對水生生態系之損害？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have water quality standards and guidelines for water discharges (to uphold water quality in order to protect ecosystems, wildlife, and human health and welfare, etc.)?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有排水水質標準與指引（以維護水質、保護生態系、野生動物與人類健康福祉）？

fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有減少校園塑膠廢棄物之行動計畫？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a policy on preventing and reducing marine pollution of all kinds, in particular from land-based activities?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有防止並減少各類海洋污染之政策（尤其陸域活動來源）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body support and/or organise events aimed to promote conservation and sustainable utilisation of the land, including forests and wild land?

fields.zh: 貴校是否直接維護並擴展既有生態系及其動植物生物多樣性，尤其受威脅生態系？

fields.en: Does your university as a body offer educational programmes on ecosystems (looking at wild flora and fauna) for local or national communities?
fields.zh: 貴校是否為地方或全國社區提供生態系教育計畫（關注野生動植物）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body offer educational programme/outreach for local or national communities on sustainable management of land for agriculture?
fields.zh: 貴校是否為地方或全國社區提供農業土地永續管理之教育／外展？

fields.zh: 貴校是否為地方或全國社區提供觀光土地永續管理之教育／外展？

fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有政策，確保與大學相關陸域生態系（尤其森林、山岳與旱地）之保育、復育與永續利用？

fields.en: Does your university as a body include local biodiversity into any planning and development process (e.g. construction of new buildings)?

fields.en: Does your university as a body have water quality standards and guidelines for water discharges (to uphold water quality in order to protect ecosystems, wildlife, and human health and welfare, etc.)?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有排水水質標準與指引（以維護水質、保護生態系、野生動物與人類健康福祉）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have written policies and procedures to identify local stakeholders external to the university and engage with them?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有書面政策與程序，以識別校外地方利害關係人並與之互動？

fields.en: Does your university as a body ensure that local stakeholders in the university, including local residents, local government, and civil society representatives (which may include groups such as refugee resettlement agencies), have a meaningful mechanism or for participating in university decision making? Yes Yes
fields.zh: 貴校是否確保大學之地方利害關係人（含地方居民、地方政府與公民社會代表，可含難民安置機構等）有有意義之機制參與大學決策？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a publication of the university's principles and commitments on organized crime, corruption & bribery?
fields.zh: 貴校是否公開大學對組織犯罪、貪腐與賄賂之原則與承諾？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a policy on supporting academic freedom (freedom to choose areas of research and to speak and teach publicly about the area of their research)?
fields.zh: 貴校是否訂有支持學術自由之政策（選擇研究領域，以及公開談論與教授其研究領域之自由）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body have a publication of university financial data?
fields.zh: 貴校是否公開大學財務資料？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide specific expert advice to local, regional or national government (e.g. through policy guidance, participation in committees, provision of evidence)?
fields.zh: 貴校是否向地方、區域或國家政府提供具體專家建議（如政策指引、參與委員會、提供證據）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide outreach, general education, upskilling and capacity-building to policy- and law-makers on relevant topics e.g. economics, law, technology, migration and displacement, and climate change?
fields.zh: 貴校是否向政策與立法者提供外展、通識、培力與能力建構（含經濟、法律、技術、移民與流離、氣候變遷等）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body undertake policy-focused research in collaboration with government departments?
fields.zh: 貴校是否與政府部門合作進行政策導向研究？

fields.en: Does your university as a body provide a neutral platform and "safe" space for different political stakeholders to come together to frankly discuss challenges?
fields.zh: 貴校是否提供中立平台與「安全」空間，供不同政治利害關係人坦誠討論挑戰？

fields.en: Does your university as a body initiate and participate in cross-sectoral dialogue about the SDGs, e.g. conferences involving government/NGOs?
fields.zh: 貴校是否發起並參與 SDG 跨部門對話（如含政府或 NGO 之會議）？

fields.en: Does your university as a body, through international collaboration and research, review comparative approaches and develop international best practice on tackling the SDGs?
